doc_title: Elements of Music: Rhythm, Melody, and Harmony
source: CK-12 Music Fundamentals Concepts, Section 2.1, CC-BY-NC
notes: New domain added to the corpus (arts/music, previously absent). Class B document (12 units). Covers the three core musical elements with audio examples (only document in the corpus using type=audio).

units.label: Hook: audio clip, a cappella song (audio)
units.content_summary: Short a cappella audio clip of a simple folk melody, used to introduce the idea that even without instruments, music has structure.

units.label: Learning Objectives (text)
units.content_summary: Objectives: define rhythm, melody, and harmony; identify each element by ear in a short piece; describe how the three elements combine in a song.

units.label: Rhythm: definition (text)
units.content_summary: Rhythm is the pattern of sounds and silences in time — the 'beat' of music. It includes tempo (speed) and meter (grouping of beats, e.g. 4/4 time).

units.label: Rhythm audio example (audio)
units.content_summary: Audio clip of a drum pattern in 4/4 time, with clear strong and weak beats, isolated from melody or harmony to highlight rhythm alone.

units.label: Melody: definition (text)
units.content_summary: Melody is a sequence of single notes that form a recognizable musical line — often what you hum or whistle. Melodies move up and down in pitch over time.

units.label: Melody notation diagram (image)
units.content_summary: Simple musical staff showing a short melodic line (e.g. the opening of 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star') with note names labeled above each note.

units.label: Harmony: definition (text)
units.content_summary: Harmony is the combination of multiple notes played together (chords) that support and enrich the melody. Harmony adds depth and emotional color to a piece.

units.label: Harmony audio example (audio)
units.content_summary: Audio clip playing the same melody first alone, then with a chord accompaniment added, letting the listener hear the difference harmony makes.

units.label: All three elements combined (video)
units.content_summary: Video of a small ensemble performing a short piece, with on-screen labels pointing out the rhythm (drums), melody (lead instrument), and harmony (chords) as they occur simultaneously.

units.label: Practice: identify the elements (text)
units.content_summary: Students listen to three short audio clips (not included in this annotation) and identify which element (rhythm, melody, or harmony) is most prominent in each.
